No. 55/1/1/80-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

#/texts/6.label: paragraph
#/texts/6.full_gt_text: The undersigned is directed to say that the Council of Ministers as shown in Annexure 'A' have relinquished their respective offices with effect from the forenoon of 14th January, 1980.

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text: 2. Smt. Indira Gandhi has been sworn-in as the Prime Minister by the President at 10-45 A.M. today, 14th January, 1980, in the Rashtrapati Bhavan. Other Ministers sworn-in by the President at 10-45 A.M. today, 14th January, 1980 are shown at Annexure 'B'.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text: 3. Ministry of Home Affairs may kindly take such action as may be considered necessary regarding issue of Gazette Notifications, etc.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text:
(K. Ramiah)
Deputy Secretary to the Cabinet.
